## String References

- **7667**: [Cutscene] The fortress city of San d'Oria lies to the north on the great continent of Quon. The beating heart of an ancient kingdom, it is home to a thousand legends past.
- **7668**: [Cutscene] But now, her reign of glory is but a memory. Heroes raise shining swords to the heavens no more.
- **7669**: [Cutscene] The sun has set on the kingdom of knights. An old lion, never to rise again... Thus do some dismiss her now.
- **7670**: [Cutscene] Yet young Elvaan knights still venture proudly into the wilds of Vana'diel, determined to triumph over any foe.
